comparison.objective: Plank two scaffold bays with boards lapped over the middle putlog and ends projecting 19–38 mm; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests long-plank handling, support placement, overlap, and end alignment; candidate tests fine inserted-tool manipulation, counterholding, locking, and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correct lap/support geometry and specified end projections; candidate requires two quantitatively safe stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Structural placement over supports does not test an adjustable energy absorber. No specs or board-stability/damage thresholds are supplied.
